description: This file defines a React component for displaying and managing a 'Reporting Attributes Mapping' tab within a larger asset management frontend. It handles CRUD operations for reporting attribute mappings, including data fetching, form handling, validation, and UI rendering with modals and data tables.

methods.name: buildProgramIndex
methods.description: Builds a Map from reporting program IDs to their master DTOs for quick lookups.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches and updates the reporting attribute mappings for the current asset.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes form state for creating a new reporting attribute mapping and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates form state with existing mapping data for editing and opens the modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles validation and submits the create or update request for a reporting attribute mapping.
